slot_note: seed DQ02 (release-health alert on the average user's rate). Architecture 1 (a smart-meter data provider's read-health alert, decided by the unit of the build mean's standard error) is spent on the portal's determinism QC and the cracked estimand rework; architecture 2 (a third-party logistics operator's stock-record accuracy gate, decided by the state of each record at one moment rebuilt from the accrual since its last count) is spent at hardening loop 1. Architecture 3, the number's last, keeps the objective and re-roots in a new world and a new client domain: a city's permanent cycle-counter network in urban and regional science, decided by the flow at which cyclists actually pass a loop once a crossing signal gates them.
niche: a city's permanent cycle-counter network: from which month of the 2027 counting season each counter site will record fewer than nine in ten of the cyclists passing it in the weekday peak hours, once four rail-trail crossings become signal controlled and cycling grows through the season
answer: Upgrade or flag the Old Spur Trail counters at Hallett Avenue and Ravine Road from May 2027, at Gorse Street from June and at Mallory Drive from July, and the Cutler Bridge counter from August; the other eleven sites hold the 90 per cent capture standard through October (planned; the builder confirms it from the cut pack).
answer_source: design note, planned schedule (prototype proto3/ladder.py); replaced by the golden at ship
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans every counter export and reads the counting standard, the counter maker's capture curve and the crossing design summary correctly applies the curve at each channel's forecast 2027 weekday peak-hour flow and files that only the busiest bridge drops below 90 per cent (in August), because nothing the hour's average shows changes at the trail; the four trail sites just beyond the newly signalled crossings fall below the standard from May, May, June and July.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the flow at which cyclists actually cross a counter's loop, and traffic signal control sets it: a crossing signal releases each cycle's cyclists in its green, so beyond the crossing the flow while they pass is the cycle's cyclists over the green, several times the hour's average; with another field's nouns there is no signal cycle gating arrivals and no loop whose capture falls with the passing flow, so the task does not survive the swap.

world.org_type: a city's transportation department running a permanent cycle-counter network, funded in part by a provincial active transportation fund

driver: The decisive quantity is the rate at which units pass a counting point while they actually pass, which a gate upstream confines to a short open phase of each cycle; a counter whose capture falls as that rate rises records far less of a gated stream than the period's average rate implies, so a capture curve validated where arrivals were ungated and applied at the average rate passes points that the new gate pushes below the standard.
driver_concrete: Four Old Spur Trail crossings of arterial roads become signal controlled in May and June 2027, so every cyclist reaching a counter loop 40 metres beyond a crossing in that direction passes during the trail's 18 to 20 second green of a 90 to 110 second cycle; the Tallis loop records 0.55 points fewer for every extra cyclist a minute of steady flow, so at the green-phase flow (four and a half to six times the hour's average) those channels fall below 90 per cent from the month their signal starts, while every video audit that certifies the loop's curve was taken where cyclists arrived unsignalled.
stump: A competent solver applies the counter maker's capture curve to each channel's forecast 2027 weekday peak-hour flow (and, if careful, to the busiest quarter hour) and files that the network holds the 90 per cent standard all season except Cutler Bridge in August; the step that lands it there is taking the hour's average flow as the flow cyclists cross the loop at, when at the four Old Spur Trail crossings signalled from May and June every cyclist leaving a crossing passes the loop 40 metres on inside the trail's green, so those four sites fall below 90 per cent from May, May, June and July.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-11: shipped, then failed the portal's determinism QC with both reviewers (the standard error's construction was not forced: the old 7 and 4.3 read literally as sample SD over root n); the in-house Gate H pass called its first domain (energy-systems-utilities) a backdrop (H1); the estimand-route rework under general-statistics-data-science was cracked on the leak reader's first pass (the filed estimand named co-moving losses and the field reference named the node)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the standard error of a mean over entities that fail together through a shared parent node, so it has to be built over the nodes; an error that takes each entity as an independent unit understates it severalfold for a group concentrated behind few nodes, and the alert fires on what is node noise.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-11 at hardening loop 1 (paper): solver round 1 landed the call and cracked every ask (proxy 97.9) by fitting an error rate per centre and class on the routine counts against days since the face's last count, the design's own rung 3, found from a visible symptom (routine-count accuracy falling with days since the previous count); no rung above that accrual model completes with its checks passing and still lands wrong, so the architecture was re-rooted

spine.file: pick-face count history, Thornacre lines, eight centres, export start to the stand-down
spine.entity: one count task on one pick face (a cycle count or an exception count), with the system quantity, the first count, the supervisor recount where one was taken, the quantity posted, the result and the task's reason code

world.geography: United Kingdom, England, Scotland and Wales
world.org_type: third-party logistics operator running ambient, chilled and frozen distribution centres for a grocery retail client

lineage.niche: a third-party logistics operator's peak stock-record gate for a grocery client: which of the eight distribution centres it runs for the client carry pick-face stock records accurate enough, at the moment counting stands down for the peak freeze, for the client's automated replenishment to order off them unattended, judged from a perpetual count programme whose cycle and exception counts each correct the record they read
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of units in a correct state at one moment, seen only through checks that record a unit's state just before setting it right; scheduled checks see each unit at the end of its interval and symptom-led checks see units because they were wrong, so the checked-unit rate, however reweighted to the population's cells, measures states that have since been reset, and the share at the moment is built unit by unit from what each has accrued since its own last check of any kind, with the accrual read from the scheduled checks alone.
lineage.driver_concrete: Corderoy's cycle and exception counts each record a pick face's system quantity against the physical count and then post the confirmed count as the record, so every count leaves the record right; the routine counts on the A, B and C cycles of four, eight and thirteen weeks see each record at the end of its cycle and the exception counts see records because a short pick or a negative balance showed them wrong, while at the stand-down each face is only part way through its cycle since its last count of any kind; so a centre's count accuracy, even with the exception counts set aside and the routine counts weighted to its A, B and C mix, understates the records it carries into the freeze, most where fast faces run long cycles, and Thornacre's 97.0 per cent gate passes six centres where the weighted count rate passes two.
lineage.stump: A competent solver takes each centre's share of correct records from its count history as the share of count tasks that matched the record and finds that no centre qualifies, all eight held on supervised replenishment, and its textbook correction (exception counts set aside as symptom-led, the routine counts weighted to the in-scope A, B and C mix) still passes only Magor and Hinckley; the step that lands it there is reading a count's result as the record's standing state, when every count also posts the confirmed quantity as the record, so routine counts see each record at the end of its cycle and exception counts see records because they were wrong, while at 06:00 on 7 December each face is only part way through its cycle since its last count of any kind, and built face by face from the accrual since that count, read off the routine counts alone, Hinckley, Daventry, Bellshill, Warrington, Magor and Avonmouth clear 97.0 per cent.

notes: Architecture 3 drawn 2026-10-12 (re-root of the number's last architecture, designer pass on branch perssathya/task229-rework). Decisive G-code G7 (operating window: a cyclist leaving a signalled crossing can pass the counter only in the trail's green), with G13 (the 2027 season, the months the crossings switch on); pattern none.
